services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: Known for its love of the outdoors, Asheville is full of people who work hard AND play hard. For over 30 years, Skydive Carolina has proudly served guests from Asheville, NC. If you’re located in the area and are looking for the best skydiving near you, we hope you’ll come play 14,000 ft up in our Carolina skies just over the North Carolina border. Skydive Carolina has a long history in the sport of skydiving offering some of the most modern, well-maintained skydiving aircraft available. We know how to make first-time skydivers feel at ease, safe, and comfortable.
